verdict.rationale: Mixpanel provides raw event export (JSONL) and Engage API for user profiles, plus CSV export, all in open/standard formats (JSON/CSV), letting users pull out their event and profile data. However, this covers analytics event data only, not necessarily every configuration, dashboard, or account-level metadata, and there's no evidence of a one-click full-account export/deletion bundle beyond GDPR-oriented deletion/retrieval APIs. missing for 10: full account/config export beyond events & profiles, evidence of bulk complete data portability workflow, independent confirmation of format fidelity on large-scale exports.
